editionLabel: alea reissued English edition (2020 rulebook printing)
firstPlayerRule: For the standard base game, each player rolls one die; the highest result starts. Give the starting player the white die and put their turn-order piece on top of the initial stack on space 1 of the bridge.
houseFallback: Reroll among players tied for the highest result until one player wins.
clarifications: The starter receives one worker. Continue clockwise, giving the next players two, three and four workers as applicable; stack their bridge pieces underneath the starter's in that order.
At the start of a round, everyone rolls their two dice. The starter also rolls the white die, uses it to place the round's goods tile, then takes the first turn.
Later turns follow bridge position: nearer the city center acts earlier, with the top piece first within a stack. Placing a ship advances a piece and can change who starts the next round.
This answer covers the standard base game. The team and solo variants have separate setup instructions on pages 13 and 14.

internalEvidence: Correction reviewed 2026-10-17 by Codex /root/indexing_recovery and independently by /root after visually inspecting rendered publisher manual pages 1, 3, 4, 5, 13, 14 and 16. Official product https://www.ravensburger.us/en-US/pdp/26925 identifies the reissue with expansions and links its Instructions download directly to https://product-files.ravensburger.cloud/manuals/664462.pdf. The 16-page English manual, code 238798-A, has a 2011/2020 publisher imprint on page 16; the edition label accurately identifies that printing while retaining the existing 2019 reissue URL and identity. Page 3 explicitly selects the highest die result, assigns the white die and initial bridge stack; no first-player tile is specified. Pages 4–5 establish first actual turn and subsequent bridge order. Team and solo setup on pages 13–14 are outside this base-game answer. Equal initial die results have no stated procedure in the cited setup; reroll is explicitly a house fallback. Replaced the incorrect citation to the original 12-page 2011 manual, SHA-256 6fb4eb68f7fc788d9c68f325e310648def996faf16016aa81140c6f3dc798b1c. The separately indexed original-edition record remains unchanged. Source custody: research/source-files/indexing-oct17-burgundy/ravensburger-26925-en.pdf; SHA-256 46b59905e23e6b6d799abedb68db0f5400ff5876d25591cb1ebe50b469987242. Existing product image and its fair-use assessment retained; publisher item 26925 matches its recorded source. No other edition or printing is asserted to share every rule.
uncertainty: The setup text does not prescribe a dice-roll tie-break.
